method: Official documentation review; no production SLA or quota test

entries.name: NASA POWER Agroclimatology API
entries.description: Global agricultural climate time series for temperature, precipitation, humidity, solar radiation and wind; hourly, daily, monthly and climatology data
entries.coverage: 全球；气象数据最早约 1981 年至近实时，按数据集而异
entries.limitations: 空间分辨率不是田块级；单次参数数和请求频率受限制

entries.name: Open-Meteo Agricultural Weather
entries.description: Keyless agricultural weather forecast with soil temperature, multi-layer soil moisture, reference evapotranspiration ET0, precipitation and solar radiation
entries.coverage: 全球；通常提供未来 7 天，部分模式可到 16 天
entries.limitations: 模型格点不等于田间传感器；商用与高频使用需核对许可方案

entries.name: ISRIC SoilGrids REST API
entries.description: Global gridded soil properties by coordinate and depth including pH, organic carbon, clay, sand, silt, nitrogen and bulk density
entries.coverage: 全球约 250 米格网，多土层预测值
entries.limitations: REST v2 仍为 beta；官方公平使用建议每分钟不超过 5 次调用

entries.name: USDA NRCS Soil Data Access
entries.description: United States soil survey tabular and spatial data through REST POST, WFS and WMS services for soil properties and land interpretations
entries.coverage: 美国 Soil Survey Geographic 数据及解释
entries.limitations: REST 查询使用 POST 和 SQL；数据结构复杂，建议服务端封装

entries.name: USDA NASS Quick Stats API
entries.description: Official United States crop, livestock, farm economics, demographics, environmental and agricultural production statistics by commodity, location and time
entries.coverage: 美国全国、州、县等层级；调查与农业普查数据
entries.limitations: 需要申请 API Key；查询维度和结果量需要控制

entries.name: USDA MyMarketNews API
entries.description: Agricultural commodity market reports with prices, volume and trade data for livestock, dairy, grain, fruit and vegetables
entries.coverage: 美国农业市场新闻与分品类报告
entries.limitations: 官方说明不支持直接浏览器调用；通常按报告而非商品直接检索

entries.name: FAOSTAT API
entries.description: Global crop production, livestock, food balance, agricultural trade, prices, inputs, emissions and food security statistics
entries.provider: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
entries.coverage: 245 个以上国家和地区；多数主题从 1961 年至最新可用年份
entries.limitations: 不同主题更新时间与口径不同；使用前确认指标、单位和版本

entries.name: EPPO Data Services REST API
entries.description: Plant and crop pest taxonomy, EPPO codes, host plants, geographical distribution, quarantine status and plant protection data
entries.provider: European and Mediterranean Plant Protection Organization
entries.coverage: 农业、林业与植物保护相关物种和检疫性有害生物；重点为 EPPO 区域
entries.limitations: 需要免费注册；不同数据集和批量服务的访问条件可能不同

entries.name: Pl@ntNet Plant Identification API
entries.description: Image-based plant and crop species identification from leaf, flower, fruit or bark photos with confidence scores
entries.coverage: 多地区植物物种识别项目；支持选择 flora/project
entries.limitations: 需要 API Key 和配额；单次最多 5 张同一植株图片，结果需人工复核

entries.name: Copernicus Data Space STAC API
entries.description: Satellite earth observation catalogue for Sentinel imagery used in crop monitoring, vegetation indices, field change and drought analysis
entries.coverage: 全球 Sentinel-1/2/3 等地球观测产品目录
entries.limitations: STAC 主要用于检索影像元数据；下载、处理和生成 NDVI 可能需要额外认证与计算

entries.name: World Bank Indicators API
entries.description: Country agricultural land, cereal yield, rural population, food production, fertilizer, water and agriculture value-added indicators
entries.coverage: 全球国家和地区的长期发展指标时间序列
entries.limitations: 并非田块或实时数据；必须选择正确指标代码并理解统计口径

entries.name: USDA ESMIS REST API
entries.description: Search agricultural economics publications, agencies and report releases from the USDA Economics, Statistics and Market Information System
entries.coverage: USDA 农业经济、市场和统计出版物及发布记录
entries.limitations: 主要返回出版物与发布元数据，不等同于报告中的完整结构化统计值
